summary: Texas broadcaster Alex Jones rose from Austin public access to build InfoWars, profiting from fear-driven conspiracy theories and dubious supplements, inspiring violent fans and smearing Sandy Hook families until lawsuits and 2018 platform bans hit him.

evidence.note: born in Dallas in 1974, raised in suburban Rockwall
after high school joins Austin public access; blames government for 1995 Oklahoma City bombing
fired from radio, starts the InfoWars website and home broadcasts
2011 Google-bombing campaign and InfoWars feeding stories to Drudge
watchdog finds lead above legal limits in InfoWars supplements
series of shooters who followed Jones, starting with the Giffords shooting
Sandy Hook false-flag claims and harassment of victims' parents
former employee's complaint alleging racism and harassment at InfoWars
marriage, 2015 divorce and custody trial with abuse claims from his ex-wife
Sandy Hook families' defamation suit against InfoWars

notes: Lifetime rule sets covered_span 1974-2018; main_span starts with his 1995 public access career. domestic-abuse rests on the ex-wife's custody-trial allegations, not proven abuse. Mass shootings fit terrorism only loosely (political violence by fans). Sexual harassment in the employee complaint was a short segment, so sexual-abuse was left out.
